## v0.5.9 · Runtime Archive Destinations and Legacy Session Recovery

- [#252](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/252): let capacity-triggering Runtime writes use the owning Source's eligible archive destinations, including spaces activated or created after recall was pinned. Recheck authority before each batch and preserve pending input on refusal.
- [#253](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/253): extend explicit legacy Session copy repair to the three known summaries, compatible v2 descriptors, empty/null stream placeholders and provable restoration of previously recorded provider tool IDs. Keep original artifacts, unrelated plugins and call/result content intact; refuse ambiguous histories.
- [#249](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/249): align the Mnemon sidebar label with sibling plugin entries.

### Packages and upgrade

New publications: **dsh-mnemon 0.5.9** and **dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces 0.5.7**. The other fifteen pinned plugins keep their existing versions.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.9
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. Legacy repair remains an explicit preview/new-copy operation. No tool ID is generated, and Issue #251 remains open for confirmation against the reporter's original Windows artifacts.

### 中文说明

本版修复容量维护首次写入误报“没有合格空间”，扩展旧会话副本修复，并调整侧栏文字对齐。旧会话修复覆盖已知 summary、兼容 descriptor、空值流占位和可证明的既有工具 ID 恢复；原文件与其他插件内容得到保留，有歧义的历史继续拒绝输出。

主包发布 0.5.9，Memory Spaces Source 发布 0.5.7，其余十五个插件保持现有固定版本。升级后重启 DSH；旧会话需要显式预览并写入新副本。Issue #251 保留用于原始 Windows 文件的恢复确认。

The combined fixes passed 1,452 tests, real CLI/WebUI verification and independent plugin installation, with 26 preserved screenshots. The release workflow verifies the versioned artifacts, npm composition and real Registry upgrade before creating this Release.

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.9/docs/en/releases/v0.5.9.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.9/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.9.md).
